sections.Description:
Star Wars Pinball features the best of the beloved franchise, featuring the cast of Episodes IV, V, & VI

Star Wars Pinball will immerse players in the dynamic and challenging Star Wars pinball environment as they battle to restore justice to the Galaxy. The game includes select speech and footage from the original Star Wars trilogy.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- New Mini Screen: Providing more information, scenes from the movie and the ability to Destroy Tie Fighters!
- Destroy the Death Star: Shoot the modulating ramp to Destroy the Death Star and experience the interactive hyperspace loop to relive your favorite scenes right out of the movie.
- Directly from the Movies!: Featuring the best of the beloved franchise (Episodes IV, V, & VI), seelect from 4 different characters, 4 Locations that feature 3 different modes.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Original John Williams Star Wars music from an incredible stereo high fidelity sound system.
- 4.25" Color HD center mounted playfield display gives players interactive access to playn stats and information.
- All models feature beautiful hand-drawn art by a cadre of talented artists featuring color changing LED illuminated inserts.

Premium:
- Interactive Magnetic Hyperdrive Ball Accelerator speeds multiple balls furiously around a circuit above the playfield.
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.
- 16 Missions, 1 Wizard Mode with 9 distinct Multiball Modes deliver incredible depth and breadth of play.

Limited Edition:
- Interactive Magnetic Hyperdrive Ball Accelerator speeds multiple balls furiously around a circuit above the playfield.
- Limited Edition model feature hand-drawn exclusive plastics art and Limited Edition exclusive theme Full Color High Definition decal material cabinet art.
- 16 Missions, 1 Wizard Mode with 9 distinct Multiball Modes deliver incredible depth and breadth of play.
